desc: Add a hard 16 KiB total-size alignment check to scripts/t6040-raw-object-verify.py (fail, not warn) for any object intended for enrollment, mirroring the padding the builder now applies. Root cause context: ticket 129 — a non-page-aligned enrolled object is never executed by iBoot. Also worth documenting the invariant in docs/BOOTABLE_BUILD_EXPERIMENTS.md and the ticket-080 raw-object contract. Small, offline. ALSO 2026-07-25 (claude): raise the object-size POLICY ceiling from the assumed 64 MiB to 256 MiB measured-good (ticket 137 loaded a 256 MiB object in full; no ceiling found at any tested size). Keep a policy limit so a runaway object is still caught, but stop treating size as a design constraint. Evidence: done/2026-07-25-t6040-object-size-ceiling.md.
author: claude
